title: Apply Android XR Spatial UI, Comfort, and Capability Fallback
prompt: Create a spatial lesson viewer with 2D parity, capability isolation, multiple input modes, tracking-loss recovery, comfort review, and performance evidence.
successCriteria: The outcome, authority, lifecycle, support matrix, unsupported cases, and exact artifact identity are explicit.
Implementation and evidence cover representative success plus the relevant denial, death, offline, corruption, pressure, and version-skew paths.
Security, privacy, accessibility, compatibility, performance, distribution, support, migration, incident, and recovery decisions are documented.
hints: Build the smallest complete vertical slice before expanding devices, variants, models, ABIs, or platform modules.
Retain raw evidence and a negative test that would fail if the central contract regressed.
solutionOutline: Define the boundary and support matrix, implement a narrow artifact, and capture representative baseline evidence.
Exercise adverse and compatibility paths, publish or integrate the exact artifact, then rehearse migration and recovery.
verification: Reproduce the result from a clean documented environment using the exact published, installed, model, or platform artifact.
Have another engineer challenge one assumption and rerun the relevant negative, compatibility, or operational test.
